introduction: North Carolina unemployment benefits provide temporary payments to eligible workers. MyNCUIBenefits handles claims and weekly certifications.
description: North Carolina unemployment benefits provide temporary payments to eligible workers. MyNCUIBenefits handles claims and weekly certifications.

sections.who: DES reviews work history and separation. Applicants must meet ongoing ability, availability and work-search conditions.
